b78ae93e3d6ecb86.description: About the Role Wataniya Insurance Co. is seeking an Anti-Money Laundering Manager to lead the development, implementation, and oversight of the Company's Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF), and sanctions compliance program. This full-time role ensures adherence to Saudi AML laws and Insurance Authority requirements, focusing on financial crime risk management and regulatory compliance. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain the Company's AML/CFT framework. Conduct enterprise AML risk assessments. Ensure compliance with Saudi AML regulations and Insurance Authority requirements. Oversee Customer Due Diligence, Enhanced Due Diligence, and Know Your Customer (KYC) processes. Monitor suspicious transactions and financial crime indicators. Review and approve Suspicious Transaction Reports before submission to the Saudi Financial Intelligence Unit, where applicable. Manage sanctions screening and watchlist monitoring. Lead AML investigations and recommend corrective actions. Monitor AML regulatory developments and implement required changes. Develop AML policies, procedures, and controls. Coordinate AML regulatory inspections and audits. Deliver AML awareness and training programs. Report AML metrics and emerging risks to senior management and relevant committees. Manage AML systems and monitoring tools. Provide AML advisory support to business units. Act on behalf of the Head of Compliance when required, ensuring continuity of departmental leadership, oversight, decision-making, and key compliance activities during their absence. Support the Head of Compliance in overseeing critical departmental matters and assume delegated responsibilities as required. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing, or sanctions compliance within the financial or insurance sector. The position requires a strong understanding of Saudi AML laws and Insurance Authority requirements. Skills and Competencies Proficiency in developing and maintaining AML/CFT frameworks. Ability to conduct enterprise AML risk assessments and manage compliance. Strong analytical skills for transaction monitoring and financial crime indicator identification. Experience in managing sanctions screening and watchlist monitoring. Leadership capabilities for AML investigations and corrective action recommendations. Excellent communication skills for regulatory reporting and training program delivery. Competence in managing AML systems and monitoring tools. Work Environment This is a full-time position within Wataniya Insurance Co., where the AML Manager will play a central role in maintaining the company's compliance integrity and contributing to its robust financial crime prevention efforts.

Industrial Complex, Riyadh The center of alfanar’s industrial activities is alfanar Industrial Complex situated in the Third Industrial Zone on Al-Kharj Road, Riyadh. Spread across 700,000 square meters, the Complex houses alfanar’s facilities. The Complex has a comprehensive infrastructure including a data and communication center as well as a commercial zone. Job Purpose To manage and coordinate outbound logistics operations within the section, ensuring the timely, cost-effective, and accurate delivery of finished goods to customers, projects, and distribution centers. The role supervises transportation planning, shipment execution, and logistics provider performance, while maintaining compliance with company policies, service standards, and customer requirements. Functional Responsibilities Outbound Logistics Planning Plan and schedule outbound shipments based on sales orders, project timelines, and customer requirements. Consolidate shipment requests to optimize transportation costs and improve delivery efficiency. Assign transporters in coordination with procurement and logistics guidelines. Transportation and Distribution Management Oversee the daily dispatch of finished goods to wholesale, project, and export customers. Monitor shipment progress and ensure on-time delivery while minimizing delays and penalties. Coordinate with transport providers to resolve issues and ensure service quality. Service Provider Performance Monitoring Evaluate transporter performance against key criteria, including on-time delivery, order completion, and service reliability. Conduct regular meetings with logistics providers to review performance and implement improvement measures. Documentation and Compliance Ensure the accuracy and completeness of shipping documents, including Proof of Delivery (POD). Maintain compliance with relevant regulations, contractual obligations, and company policies. Cost Control and Optimization Identify opportunities to reduce outbound logistics costs through route optimization, load consolidation, and negotiation with service providers. Manage quotations and approvals for shipments to non-contracted destinations. Issue Resolution Address operational issues related to delivery delays, POD discrepancies, and payment processing for logistics providers. Escalate recurring or critical issues to higher management with recommended corrective actions. Team Supervision Supervise section staff handling outbound logistics operations, ensuring adherence to procedures and timelines. Provide guidance, training, and support to improve team efficiency and performance. Reporting and KPIs Track and report section-level KPIs, such as on-time delivery, logistics cost per shipment, and transporter performance. Prepare regular reports for management on outbound logistics performance and improvement initiatives. Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions. Delivery: Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost. Monitor the plan performance and initiate action to strengthen results and take the corrective action accordingly. Provide periodic work progress reports. Responsible for monitoring and controlling budgets and expenses to achieve the optimum cost efficiency. b76978b703373f05.description: Company Description LogeMate is a Saudi-born, end-to-end logistics ecosystem that helps growing enterprises, e-commerce brands, and 3PL providers across the Kingdom simplify complex operations and scale effectively. Backed by over 25 years of hands-on operational expertise and closely aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, LogeMate connects strategic advisory, physical infrastructure, and rapid procurement in one integrated platform. The company operates across three core pillars: flexible warehousing and space solutions, logistics advisory and warehouse optimization, and smart e-procurement for mission-critical equipment and materials. By supporting everything from network design and dock-to-stock flow optimization to floor-level tools and technology integration, LogeMate serves as a single accountable partner for building faster, smarter, and more resilient supply chains. Role Description The Operations Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, responsible for overseeing day-to-day logistics and warehousing activities across LogeMate’s operational pillars. This role manages operational workflows, monitors performance metrics, and ensures efficient utilization of warehouse space, equipment, and staffing. The Operations Manager coordinates with internal teams and external partners to optimize processes, resolve operational issues, and maintain high standards of safety, quality, and compliance. Key responsibilities include implementing best practices for inventory management, supervising inbound and outbound flows, supporting technology and systems integration, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The role also involves forecasting operational needs, supporting strategic projects aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, and providing clear reporting and insights to senior leadership. Qualifications Strong operations management skills across logistics, warehousing, and supply chain oversight, including hands-on experience in 3PL or e-commerce environments. Proficiency in process optimization, performance analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks). Experience with logistics technologies and systems, such as Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), and inventory tracking tools. Ability to manage cross-functional teams, coordinate with stakeholders, and communicate clearly across operational, technical, and leadership levels. Knowledge of safety, compliance, and risk management standards within warehousing and logistics operations. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple operational initiatives. Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; advanced certifications are a plus. Minimum 5 years of experience working in Saudi Arabia or GCC markets and familiarity with Saudi Vision 2030 objectives in the logistics sector.
